workflow.name: Chat with PDF/MD/Text Files using GraphRAG
workflow.description: Ingest documents from local folder into a graph-based knowledge store, then chat with the documents using an LLM with GraphRAG context.
workflow.origin: n8n workflow: Chat with PDF / MD / Text Files using GraphRAG (no vector store needed)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for LLM calls

DATA_FOLDER.description: Path to local folder containing PDF/MD/TXT documents (mock Google Drive)

GRAPH_STORE_PATH.description: Path to local JSON graph store (mock InfraNodus)

workflow_steps.name: search_local_files
workflow_steps.description: Search for files in local folder. Replaces Google Drive Search node.

workflow_steps.name: retrieve_file
workflow_steps.description: Retrieve file metadata and path. Replaces Google Drive Download node.

workflow_steps.name: detect_file_type
workflow_steps.description: Detect file category by MIME type. Replaces Switch node. Routes to 4a/4b/4c based on detected type (pdf/text/markdown).

workflow_steps.name: extract_pdf_text
workflow_steps.description: Extract text from PDF. Selected when step_3 returns 'pdf'.

workflow_steps.name: extract_text_file
workflow_steps.description: Extract text from plain text file. Selected when step_3 returns 'text'.

workflow_steps.name: extract_markdown_file
workflow_steps.description: Extract text from Markdown file. Selected when step_3 returns 'markdown'.

workflow_steps.name: map_to_text
workflow_steps.description: Normalize extracted text content. Receives output from whichever extractor was selected by step_3.

workflow_steps.name: save_to_graph
workflow_steps.description: Save text to local graph store. Replaces InfraNodus Save to Graph HTTP node.

workflow_steps.name: clear_memory
workflow_steps.description: Clear conversation memory buffer before chat. Replaces Simple Memory reset.

workflow_steps.name: chat_with_knowledge_base
workflow_steps.description: Chat with documents using GraphRAG KB + LLM. Replaces AI Agent + OpenAI Chat Model + Knowledge Base GraphRAG nodes.
